PostMessage.description: Visually differentiate user input from agent output using ANSI colors, text styles, and delimiters. Works on terminal; desktop/web apps can parse metadata.

hooks.prompt:
A message is about to be displayed. Wrap it with visual differentiation based on role:

- If from USER: prefix with a unique marker (color + style), indent differently
- If from ASSISTANT (Claude): use a different marker (different color + style), different indent
- Include ASCII delimiters for terminal visibility

Message role: {role}
Content preview: {content:first-100-chars}

Apply styling that survives terminal scrollback and copy-paste.
hooks.fallback: If ANSI not supported, use text-only delimiters: '>>> USER >>>' and '<<< CLAUDE <<<'

user.description: Bright yellow (ANSI 33), good contrast on dark backgrounds

assistant.description: Bright cyan (ANSI 36), good contrast, distinct from user

accessibility.rationale: Uses color + ASCII borders + text style (bold) so users with color blindness or low vision can still distinguish input from output
